summary: Every checkout request is failing across all regions.
Nobody can load the customer dashboard; every page request fails.
About 30% of upload attempts time out, while remaining uploads complete.
One availability zone cannot serve traffic; the other two zones are healthy.
Only one internal canary probe returned HTTP 500; customer requests are healthy.
A single customer account sees slow requests; everyone else is unaffected.
Queue depth alert fired, but request impact has not been checked.
One operator says all users are affected; another says no customers are affected.
